title: Failing test and probe: how keep_alive reaches Ollama
goal: Failing test and probe: how keep_alive reaches Ollama
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "ollama a+b, c as option in dashboard".

A failing test (committed first) shows that a local Ollama role call (src/engine-provider.ts, completeOpenAICompatible via /v1/chat/completions) sends no keep_alive today and that, after the change, the request or its follow-up carries keep_alive with the configured value

The step records what Ollama accepts, checked on the owner Mac or against Ollama docs and noted as such: the OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint may ignore keep_alive, so the mechanism is chosen here: (1) a native /api/chat for local Ollama role calls, or (2) a cheap POST /api/generate {model, keep_alive} with no prompt after each reply, which resets the unload timer without generating; the page names the choice and why in docs/decisions/keep-model-warm.md
No other behaviour changes; remote and non-Ollama routes never receive keep_alive
privacy: Local Ollama only; test data is neutral and invented; no secrets; warm-up calls carry no user text.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the existing engine-provider, config and dashboard code; bounded edit plus tests. Not a measurement.
